sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This policy applies to Global NovaTech staff and authorized stakeholders. POC Policy is maintained by SALES Operations.

sections.heading: Policy requirement
sections.text: Default POC 30 days; extensions need Product and Sales directors.

sections.heading: Implementation steps
sections.text: 1. Log the request, business purpose, owner, and applicable region. 2. Verify the current policy version and eligibility. 3. Obtain the designated approval before execution. 4. Record the outcome and evidence in the department tracking system. 5. Escalate exceptions to SALES Operations.

sections.heading: Worked example
sections.text: A staff member asks about poc policy. The reviewer checks the rule above, validates employee scope, records approvals, and follows the related procedure in PROD-001. Do not use superseded guidance for current requests.

sections.heading: Controls and exceptions
sections.text: Exceptions need written approval from SALES Operations. Confidential or Restricted material must only be retrieved for entitled roles. The owning team reviews the policy annually.

sections.heading: Cross-department handoff
sections.text: For overlapping questions, consult PROD-001. If policies disagree, use the active version effective on the relevant date and escalate unresolved conflicts to the owners.
